speaker: john-the-baptist
text: This is He of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me because He was before me.’
name: John the Baptist

speaker: jewish-leaders
text: Who are you?
name: The priests and Levites

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: I am not the Christ.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: jewish-leaders
text: Then who are you?
name: The priests and Levites

speaker: jewish-leaders
text: Are you Elijah?
name: The priests and Levites

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: I am not.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: jewish-leaders
text: Are you the Prophet?
name: The priests and Levites

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: No.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: jewish-leaders
text: Who are you? We need an answer for those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?
name: The priests and Levites

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: I am a voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way for the Lord.’
name: John the Baptist

speaker: jewish-leaders
text: Why then do you baptize, if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?
name: The priests and Levites

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: I baptize with water,
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: but among you stands One you do not know.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: He is the One who comes after me, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: This is He of whom I said, ‘A man who comes after me has surpassed me because He was before me.’
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: I myself did not know Him, but the reason I came baptizing with water was that He might be revealed to Israel.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove and resting on Him.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: I myself did not know Him, but the One who sent me to baptize with water told me, ‘The man on whom you see the Spirit descend and rest is He who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.’
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: I have seen and testified that this is the Son of God.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: Look, the Lamb of God!
name: John the Baptist

speaker: jesus
text: What do you want?
name: Jesus

speaker: two-disciples
text: Rabbi
name: The two disciples

speaker: two-disciples
text: where are You staying?
name: The two disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Come and see,
name: Jesus

speaker: andrew
text: We have found the Messiah
name: Andrew

speaker: jesus
text: You are Simon son of John. You will be called Cephas
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Follow Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: philip
text: We have found the One Moses wrote about in the Law, the One the prophets foretold—Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.
name: Philip

speaker: nathanael
text: Can anything good come from Nazareth?
name: Nathanael

speaker: philip
text: Come and see,
name: Philip

speaker: jesus
text: Here is a true Israelite, in whom there is no deceit.
name: Jesus

speaker: nathanael
text: How do You know me?
name: Nathanael

speaker: jesus
text: Before Philip called you, I saw you under the fig tree.
name: Jesus

speaker: nathanael
text: Rabbi,
name: Nathanael

speaker: nathanael
text: You are the Son of God! You are the King of Israel!
name: Nathanael

speaker: jesus
text: Do you believe just because I told you I saw you under the fig tree? You will see greater things than these.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly, truly, I tell you, you will all see heaven open and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.
name: Jesus

speaker: mary
text: They have no more wine.
name: Mary, Jesus' mother

speaker: jesus
text: Woman, why does this concern us?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: My hour has not yet come.
name: Jesus

speaker: mary
text: Do whatever He tells you.
name: Mary, Jesus' mother

speaker: jesus
text: Fill the jars with water.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Now draw some out,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and take it to the master of the banquet.
name: Jesus

speaker: master-of-banquet
text: Everyone serves the fine wine first, and then the cheap wine after the guests are drunk. But you have saved the fine wine until now!
name: The master of the banquet

speaker: jesus
text: Get these out of here! How dare you turn My Father’s house into a marketplace!
name: Jesus

speaker: jews
text: What sign can You show us to prove Your authority to do these things?
name: The Jews

speaker: jesus
text: Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up again.
name: Jesus

speaker: jews
text: This temple took forty-six years to build,
name: The Jews

speaker: jews
text: and You are going to raise it up in three days?
name: The Jews

speaker: nicodemus
text: Rabbi, we know that You are a teacher who has come from God. For no one could perform the signs You are doing if God were not with him.
name: Nicodemus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly, truly, I tell you, no one can see the kingdom of God unless he is born again.
name: Jesus

speaker: nicodemus
text: How can a man be born when he is old?
name: Nicodemus

speaker: nicodemus
text: Can he enter his mother’s womb a second time to be born?
name: Nicodemus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly, truly, I tell you, no one can enter the kingdom of God unless he is born of water and the Spirit.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Flesh is born of flesh, but spirit is born of the Spirit.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do not be amazed that I said, ‘You must be born again.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The wind blows where it wishes. You hear its sound, but you do not know where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit.
name: Jesus

speaker: nicodemus
text: How can this be?
name: Nicodemus

speaker: jesus
text: You are Israel’s teacher,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and you do not understand these things?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly, truly, I tell you, we speak of what we know, and we testify to what we have seen, and yet you people do not accept our testimony.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If I have told you about earthly things and you do not believe, how will you believe if I tell you about heavenly things?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: No one has ascended into heaven except the One who descended from heaven—the Son of Man.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: that everyone who believes in Him may have eternal life.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through Him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Whoever believes in Him is not condemned, but whoever does not believe has already been condemned, because he has not believed in the name of God’s one and only Son.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And this is the verdict: The Light has come into the world, but men loved the darkness rather than the Light because their deeds were evil.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Everyone who does evil hates the Light, and does not come into the Light for fear that his deeds will be exposed.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But whoever practices the truth comes into the Light, so that it may be seen clearly that what he has done has been accomplished in God.
name: Jesus

speaker: johns-disciples
text: Look, Rabbi, the One who was with you beyond the Jordan, the One you testified about—He is baptizing, and everyone is going to Him.
name: John's disciples

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: A man can receive only what is given him from heaven.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: You yourselves can testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ, but am sent ahead of Him.’
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: The bride belongs to the bridegroom. The friend of the bridegroom stands and listens for him, and is overjoyed to hear the bridegroom’s voice. That joy is mine, and it is now complete.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: He must increase; I must decrease.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: The One who comes from above is above all. The one who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks as one from the earth. The One who comes from heaven is above all.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: He testifies to what He has seen and heard, yet no one accepts His testimony.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: Whoever accepts His testimony has certified that God is truthful.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: For the One whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God gives the Spirit without limit.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: The Father loves the Son and has placed all things in His hands.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life. Whoever rejects the Son will not see life. Instead, the wrath of God remains on him.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: jesus
text: Give Me a drink.
name: Jesus

speaker: samaritan-woman
text: You are a Jew,
name: The Samaritan woman

speaker: samaritan-woman
text: How can You ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?
name: The Samaritan woman

speaker: jesus
text: If you knew the gift of God and who is asking you for a drink, you would have asked Him, and He would have given you living water.
name: Jesus

speaker: samaritan-woman
text: Sir,
name: The Samaritan woman

speaker: samaritan-woman
text: You have nothing to draw with and the well is deep. Where then will You get this living water?
name: The Samaritan woman

speaker: samaritan-woman
text: Are You greater than our father Jacob, who gave us this well and drank from it himself, as did his sons and his livestock?
name: The Samaritan woman

speaker: jesus
text: Everyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But whoever drinks the water I give him will never thirst. Indeed, the water I give him will become in him a fount of water springing up to eternal life.
name: Jesus

speaker: samaritan-woman
text: Sir, give me this water so that I will not get thirsty and have to keep coming here to draw water.
name: The Samaritan woman

speaker: jesus
text: Go, call your husband and come back.
name: Jesus

speaker: samaritan-woman
text: I have no husband,
name: The Samaritan woman

speaker: jesus
text: You are correct to say that you have no husband.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: In fact, you have had five husbands, and the man you now have is not your husband. You have spoken truthfully.
name: Jesus

speaker: samaritan-woman
text: Sir,
name: The Samaritan woman

speaker: samaritan-woman
text: I see that You are a prophet.
name: The Samaritan woman

speaker: samaritan-woman
text: Our fathers worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say that the place where one must worship is in Jerusalem.
name: The Samaritan woman

speaker: jesus
text: Believe Me, woman,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: a time is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You worship what you do not know; we worship what we do know, for salvation is from the Jews.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But a time is coming and has now come when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and in truth, for the Father is seeking such as these to worship Him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: God is Spirit, and His worshipers must worship Him in spirit and in truth.
name: Jesus

speaker: samaritan-woman
text: I know that Messiah
name: The Samaritan woman

speaker: samaritan-woman
text: is coming. When He comes, He will explain everything to us.
name: The Samaritan woman

speaker: jesus
text: I who speak to you am He.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: What do You want from her?
name: The disciples

speaker: disciples
text: Why are You talking with her?
name: The disciples

speaker: samaritan-woman
text: Come, see a man who told me everything I ever did. Could this be the Christ?
name: The Samaritan woman

speaker: disciples
text: Rabbi, eat something.
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: I have food to eat that you know nothing about.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Could someone have brought Him food?
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: My food is to do the will of Him who sent Me and to finish His work.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do you not say, ‘There are still four months until the harvest’? I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, for they are ripe for harvest.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Already the reaper draws his wages and gathers a crop for eternal life, so that the sower and the reaper may rejoice together.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For in this case the saying ‘One sows and another reaps’ is true.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I sent you to reap what you have not worked for; others have done the hard work, and now you have taken up their labor.
name: Jesus

speaker: samaritan-woman
text: He told me everything I ever did.
name: The Samaritan woman

speaker: samaritans
text: We now believe not only because of your words; we have heard for ourselves, and we know that this man truly is the Savior of the world.
name: The Samaritans

speaker: jesus
text: Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will never believe.
name: Jesus

speaker: official
text: Sir,
name: The royal official

speaker: official
text: come down before my child dies.
name: The royal official

speaker: jesus
text: Go,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Your son will live.
name: Jesus

speaker: servants
text: The fever left him yesterday at the seventh hour.
name: The official's servants

speaker: jesus
text: Your son will live.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do you want to get well?
name: Jesus

speaker: invalid
text: Sir,
name: The invalid at Bethesda

speaker: invalid
text: I have no one to help me into the pool when the water is stirred. While I am on my way, someone else goes in before me.
name: The invalid at Bethesda

speaker: jesus
text: Get up, pick up your mat, and walk.
name: Jesus

speaker: jews
text: This is the Sabbath! It is unlawful for you to carry your mat.
name: The Jews

speaker: invalid
text: The man who made me well told me, ‘Pick up your mat and walk.’
name: The invalid at Bethesda

speaker: jews
text: Who is this man who told you to pick it up and walk?
name: The Jews

speaker: jesus
text: See, you have been made well. Stop sinning, or something worse may happen to you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: To this very day My Father is at His work, and I too am working.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly, truly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing by Himself, unless He sees the Father doing it. For whatever the Father does, the Son also does.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The Father loves the Son and shows Him all He does. And to your amazement, He will show Him even greater works than these.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, so also the Son gives life to whom He wishes.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Furthermore, the Father judges no one, but has assigned all judgment to the Son,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: so that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father. Whoever does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent Him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever hears My word and believes Him who sent Me has eternal life and will not come under judgment. Indeed, he has crossed over from death to life.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly, truly, I tell you, the hour is coming and has now come when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For as the Father has life in Himself, so also He has granted the Son to have life in Himself.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And He has given Him authority to execute judgment, because He is the Son of Man.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do not be amazed at this, for the hour is coming when all who are in their graves will hear His voice
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and come out—those who have done good to the resurrection of life, and those who have done evil to the resurrection of judgment.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I can do nothing by Myself; I judge only as I hear. And My judgment is just, because I do not seek My own will, but the will of Him who sent Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If I testify about Myself, My testimony is not valid.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: There is another who testifies about Me, and I know that His testimony about Me is valid.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Even though I do not accept human testimony, I say these things so that you may be saved.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: John was a lamp that burned and gave light, and you were willing for a season to bask in his light.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But I have testimony more substantial than that of John. For the works that the Father has given Me to accomplish—the very works I am doing—testify about Me that the Father has sent Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And the Father who sent Me has Himself testified about Me. You have never heard His voice nor seen His form,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: nor does His word abide in you, because you do not believe the One He sent.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You pore over the Scriptures because you presume that by them you possess eternal life. These are the very words that testify about Me,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: yet you refuse to come to Me to have life.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I do not accept glory from men,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: but I know you, that you do not have the love of God within you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I have come in My Father’s name, and you have not received Me; but if someone else comes in his own name, you will receive him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: How can you believe if you accept glory from one another, yet do not seek the glory that comes from the only God?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do not think that I will accuse you before the Father. Your accuser is Moses, in whom you have put your hope.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If you had believed Moses, you would believe Me, because he wrote about Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But since you do not believe what he wrote, how will you believe what I say?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Where can we buy bread for these people to eat?
name: Jesus

speaker: philip
text: Two hundred denarii would not buy enough bread for each of them to have a small piece.
name: Philip

speaker: andrew
text: Here is a boy with five barley loaves and two small fish. But what difference will these make among so many?
name: Andrew

speaker: jesus
text: Have the people sit down,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Gather the pieces that are left over, so that nothing will be wasted.
name: Jesus

speaker: crowd
text: Truly this is the Prophet who is to come into the world.
name: The crowd

speaker: jesus
text: It is I; do not be afraid.
name: Jesus

speaker: crowd
text: Rabbi, when did You get here?
name: The crowd

speaker: jesus
text: Truly, truly, I tell you, it is not because you saw these signs that you are looking for Me, but because you ate the loaves and had your fill.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do not work for food that perishes, but for food that endures to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For on Him God the Father has placed His seal of approval.
name: Jesus

speaker: crowd
text: What must we do to perform the works of God?
name: The crowd

speaker: jesus
text: The work of God is this: to believe in the One He has sent.
name: Jesus

speaker: crowd
text: What sign then will You perform, so that we may see it and believe You? What will You do?
name: The crowd

speaker: crowd
text: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, as it is written: ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat.’
name: The crowd

speaker: jesus
text: Truly, truly, I tell you, it was not Moses who gave you the bread from heaven, but it is My Father who gives you the true bread from heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For the bread of God is He who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world.
name: Jesus

speaker: crowd
text: Sir,
name: The crowd

speaker: crowd
text: give us this bread at all times.
name: The crowd

speaker: jesus
text: I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to Me will never hunger, and whoever believes in Me will never thirst.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But as I stated, you have seen Me and still you do not believe.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Everyone the Father gives Me will come to Me, and the one who comes to Me I will never drive away.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For I have come down from heaven, not to do My own will, but to do the will of Him who sent Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And this is the will of Him who sent Me, that I shall lose none of those He has given Me, but raise them up at the last day.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For it is My Father’s will that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in Him shall have eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.
name: Jesus

speaker: jews
text: I am the bread that came down from heaven.
name: The Jews

speaker: jews
text: Is this not Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then can He say, ‘I have come down from heaven?’
name: The Jews

speaker: jesus
text: Stop grumbling among yourselves,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: No one can come to Me unless the Father who sent Me draws him, and I will raise him up at the last day.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: It is written in the Prophets: ‘And they will all be taught by God.’ Everyone who has heard the Father and learned from Him comes to Me—
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: not that anyone has seen the Father except the One who is from God; only He has seen the Father.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly, truly, I tell you, he who believes has eternal life.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I am the bread of life.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, yet they died.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: This is the bread that comes down from heaven, so that anyone may eat of it and not die.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. And this bread, which I will give for the life of the world, is My flesh.
name: Jesus

speaker: jews
text: How can this man give us His flesh to eat?
name: The Jews

speaker: jesus
text: Truly, truly, I tell you, unless you eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man, you have no life in you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Whoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For My flesh is real food, and My blood is real drink.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Whoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood remains in Me, and I in him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Just as the living Father sent Me and I live because of the Father, so also the one who feeds on Me will live because of Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: This is the bread that came down from heaven. Unlike your fathers, who ate the manna and died, the one who eats this bread will live forever.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: This is a difficult teaching. Who can accept it?
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Does this offend you?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then what will happen if you see the Son of Man ascend to where He was before?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The Spirit gives life; the flesh profits nothing. The words I have spoken to you are spirit and they are life.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: However, there are some of you who do not believe.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: This is why I told you that no one can come to Me unless the Father has granted it to him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do you want to leave too?
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.
name: Simon Peter

speaker: peter
text: We believe and know that You are the Holy One of God.
name: Simon Peter

speaker: jesus
text: Have I not chosen you, the Twelve? Yet one of you is a devil!
name: Jesus

speaker: brothers
text: Leave here and go to Judea, so that Your disciples there may see the works You are doing.
name: Jesus' brothers

speaker: brothers
text: For no one who wants to be known publicly acts in secret. Since You are doing these things, show Yourself to the world.
name: Jesus' brothers

speaker: jesus
text: Although your time is always at hand, My time has not yet come.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The world cannot hate you, but it hates Me, because I testify that its works are evil.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Go up to the feast on your own. I am not going up to this feast, because My time has not yet come.
name: Jesus

speaker: jews
text: Where is He?
name: The Jews

speaker: crowd
text: He is a good man.
name: The crowd

text: I have glorified it, and I will glorify it again.
name: God the Father

speaker: jesus
text: This voice was not for My benefit, but yours.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Now judgment is upon this world; now the prince of this world will be cast out.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw everyone to Myself.
name: Jesus

speaker: crowd
text: We have heard from the Law that the Christ will remain forever. So how can You say that the Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man?
name: The crowd

speaker: jesus
text: For a little while longer, the Light will be among you. Walk while you have the Light, so that darkness will not overtake you. The one who walks in the darkness does not know where he is going.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: While you have the Light, believe in the Light, so that you may become sons of light.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Whoever believes in Me does not believe in Me alone, but in the One who sent Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And whoever sees Me sees the One who sent Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I have come into the world as a light, so that no one who believes in Me should remain in darkness.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: As for anyone who hears My words and does not keep them, I do not judge him. For I have not come to judge the world, but to save the world.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: There is a judge for the one who rejects Me and does not receive My words: The word that I have spoken will judge him on the last day.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I have not spoken on My own, but the Father who sent Me has commanded Me what to say and how to say it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And I know that His command leads to eternal life. So I speak exactly what the Father has told Me to say.
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Lord, are You going to wash my feet?
name: Simon Peter

speaker: jesus
text: You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand.
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Never shall You wash my feet!
name: Simon Peter

speaker: jesus
text: Unless I wash you, you have no part with Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Then, Lord,
name: Simon Peter

speaker: peter
text: not only my feet, but my hands and my head as well!
name: Simon Peter

speaker: jesus
text: Whoever has already bathed needs only to wash his feet, and he will be completely clean. And you are clean, though not all of you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Not all of you are clean.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do you know what I have done for you?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You call Me Teacher and Lord, and rightly so, because I am.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So if I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also should wash one another’s feet.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I have set you an example so that you should do as I have done for you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly, truly, I tell you, no servant is greater than his master, nor is a messenger greater than the one who sent him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If you know these things, you will be blessed if you do them.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I am not speaking about all of you; I know whom I have chosen. But this is to fulfill the Scripture: ‘The one who shares My bread has lifted up his heel against Me.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I am telling you now before it happens, so that when it comes to pass, you will believe that I am He.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever receives the one I send receives Me, and whoever receives Me receives the One who sent Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly, truly, I tell you, one of you will betray Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: beloved-disciple
text: Lord, who is it?
name: The disciple whom Jesus loved

speaker: jesus
text: It is the one to whom I give this morsel after I have dipped it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: What you are about to do, do quickly.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Now the Son of Man is glorified, and God is glorified in Him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If God is glorified in Him, God will also glorify the Son in Himself—and will glorify Him at once.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Little children, I am with you only a little while longer. You will look for Me, and as I said to the Jews, so now I say to you: ‘Where I am going, you cannot come.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: A new commandment I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you also must love one another.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: By this everyone will know that you are My disciples, if you love one another.
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Lord, where are You going?
name: Simon Peter

speaker: jesus
text: Where I am going, you cannot follow Me now, but you will follow later.
name: Jesus

text: Lord,

text: Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God; believe in Me as well.
name: Jesus

text: In My Father’s house are many rooms. If it were not so, would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you?
name: Jesus

text: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and welcome you into My presence, so that you also may be where I am.
name: Jesus

text: You know the way to the place where I am going.
name: Jesus

text: Lord,

text: I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.
name: Jesus

text: If you had known Me, you would know My Father as well. From now on you do know Him and have seen Him.
name: Jesus

text: Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.
name: Philip

name: Jesus

text: Do you not believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me? The words I say to you, I do not speak on My own. Instead, it is the Father dwelling in Me, performing His works.

text: And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Advocate to be with you forever—

text: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have told you.

text: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.

text: And now I have told you before it happens, so that when it does happen, you will believe.
name: Jesus

text: I will not speak with you much longer, for the prince of this world is coming, and he has no claim on Me.

text: But I do exactly what the Father has commanded Me, so that the world may know that I love the Father. Get up! Let us go on from here.

speaker: jesus
text: I am the true vine, and My Father is the keeper of the vineyard.
name: Jesus

name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You are already clean because of the word I have spoken to you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Remain in Me, and I will remain in you. Just as no branch can bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, neither can you bear fruit unless you remain in Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I am the vine and you are the branches. The one who remains in Me, and I in him, will bear much fruit. For apart from Me you can do nothing.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If anyone does not remain in Me, he is like a branch that is thrown away and withers. Such branches are gathered up, thrown into the fire, and burned.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If you remain in Me and My words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: This is to My Father’s glory, that you bear much fruit, proving yourselves to be My disciples.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: As the Father has loved Me, so have I loved you. Remain in My love.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If you keep My commandments, you will remain in My love, just as I have kept My Father’s commandments and remain in His love.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I have told you these things so that My joy may be in you and your joy may be complete.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: This is My commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Greater love has no one than this, that he lay down his life for his friends.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You are My friends if you do what I command you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: No longer do I call you servants, for a servant does not understand what his master is doing. But I have called you friends, because everything I have learned from My Father I have made known to you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You did not choose Me, but I chose you. And I appointed you to go and bear fruit—fruit that will remain—so that whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: This is My command to you: Love one another.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If the world hates you, understand that it hated Me first.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If you were of the world, it would love you as its own. Instead, the world hates you, because you are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Remember the word that I spoke to you: ‘No servant is greater than his master.’ If they persecuted Me, they will persecute you as well; if they kept My word, they will keep yours as well.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But they will treat you like this because of My name, since they do not know the One who sent Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. Now, however, they have no excuse for their sin.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Whoever hates Me hates My Father as well.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If I had not done among them the works that no one else did, they would not be guilty of sin; but now they have seen and hated both Me and My Father.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But this is to fulfill what is written in their Law: ‘They hated Me without reason.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When the Advocate comes, whom I will send to you from the Father—the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father—He will testify about Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And you also must testify, because you have been with Me from the beginning.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I have told you these things so that you will not fall away.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: They will put you out of the synagogues. In fact, a time is coming when anyone who kills you will think he is offering a service to God.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: They will do these things because they have not known the Father or Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But I have told you these things so that when their hour comes, you will remember that I told you about them. I did not tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Now, however, I am going to Him who sent Me; yet none of you asks Me, ‘Where are You going?’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Instead, your hearts are filled with sorrow because I have told you these things.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But I tell you the truth, it is for your benefit that I am going away. Unless I go away, the Advocate will not come to you; but if I go, I will send Him to you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And when He comes, He will convict the world in regard to sin and righteousness and judgment:
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: in regard to sin, because they do not believe in Me;
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: in regard to righteousness, because I am going to the Father and you will no longer see Me;
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and in regard to judgment, because the prince of this world has been condemned.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I still have much to tell you, but you cannot yet bear to hear it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: However, when the Spirit of truth comes, He will guide you into all truth. For He will not speak on His own, but He will speak what He hears, and He will declare to you what is to come.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He will glorify Me by taking from what is Mine and disclosing it to you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Everything that belongs to the Father is Mine. That is why I said that the Spirit will take from what is Mine and disclose it to you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: In a little while you will see Me no more, and then after a little while you will see Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Why is He telling us, ‘In a little while you will not see Me, and then after a little while you will see Me’ and ‘Because I am going to the Father’?
name: The disciples

speaker: disciples
text: Why is He saying, ‘a little while’? We do not understand what He is saying.
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Are you asking one another why I said, ‘In a little while you will not see Me, and then after a little while you will see Me’?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly, truly, I tell you, you will weep and wail while the world rejoices. You will grieve, but your grief will turn to joy.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: A woman has pain in childbirth because her time has come; but when she brings forth her child, she forgets her anguish because of her joy that a child has been born into the world.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So also you have sorrow now, but I will see you again and your hearts will rejoice, and no one will take away your joy.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: In that day you will no longer ask Me anything. Truly, truly, I tell you, whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Until now you have not asked for anything in My name. Ask and you will receive, so that your joy may be complete.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. An hour is coming when I will no longer speak to you this way, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: In that day you will ask in My name. I am not saying that I will ask the Father on your behalf.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For the Father Himself loves you, because you have loved Me and have believed that I came from God.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I came from the Father and entered the world. In turn, I will leave the world and go to the Father.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: See, now You are speaking plainly and without figures of speech.
name: The disciples

speaker: disciples
text: Now we understand that You know all things and that You have no need for anyone to question You. Because of this, we believe that You came from God.
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Do you finally believe?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Look, an hour is coming and has already come when you will be scattered, each to his own home, and you will leave Me all alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I have told you these things so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation. But take courage; I have overcome the world!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Father, the hour has come. Glorify Your Son, that Your Son may glorify You.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For You granted Him authority over all people, so that He may give eternal life to all those You have given Him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Now this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You have sent.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I have glorified You on earth by accomplishing the work You gave Me to do.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And now, Father, glorify Me in Your presence with the glory I had with You before the world existed.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I have revealed Your name to those You have given Me out of the world. They were Yours; You gave them to Me, and they have kept Your word.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Now they know that everything You have given Me comes from You.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For I have given them the words You gave Me, and they have received them. They knew with certainty that I came from You, and they believed that You sent Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I ask on their behalf. I do not ask on behalf of the world, but on behalf of those You have given Me; for they are Yours.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: All I have is Yours, and all You have is Mine; and in them I have been glorified.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I will no longer be in the world, but they are in the world, and I am coming to You. Holy Father, protect them by Your name, the name You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: While I was with them, I protected and preserved them by Your name, the name You gave Me. Not one of them has been lost, except the son of destruction, so that the Scripture would be fulfilled.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But now I am coming to You; and I am saying these things while I am in the world, so that they may have My joy fulfilled within them.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I have given them Your word and the world has hated them; for they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I am not asking that You take them out of the world, but that You keep them from the evil one.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: They are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Sanctify them by the truth; Your word is truth.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: As You sent Me into the world, I have also sent them into the world.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For them I sanctify Myself, so that they too may be sanctified by the truth.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I am not asking on behalf of them alone, but also on behalf of those who will believe in Me through their message,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: that all of them may be one, as You, Father, are in Me, and I am in You. May they also be in Us, so that the world may believe that You sent Me.
name: Jesus

text: I have given them the glory You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one—

name: Pilate

text: Do You refuse to speak to me? Do You not know that I have authority to release You and authority to crucify You?
name: Pilate

speaker: jesus
text: You would have no authority over Me if it were not given to you from above. Therefore the one who handed Me over to you is guilty of greater sin.
name: Jesus

speaker: jews
text: If you release this man, you are no friend of Caesar. Anyone who declares himself a king is defying Caesar.
name: The Jews

speaker: pilate
text: Here is your King!
name: Pilate

speaker: jews
text: Away with Him! Away with Him! Crucify Him!
name: The Jews

speaker: pilate
text: Shall I crucify your King?
name: Pilate

speaker: chief-priests
text: We have no king but Caesar,
name: The chief priests and Pharisees

speaker: chief-priests
text: Do not write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but only that He said, ‘I am the King of the Jews.’
name: The chief priests and Pharisees

speaker: pilate
text: What I have written, I have written.
name: Pilate

speaker: soldiers
text: Let us not tear it. Instead, let us cast lots to see who will get it.
name: The soldiers and officers

speaker: jesus
text: Woman, here is your son.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Here is your mother.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I am thirsty.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: It is finished.
name: Jesus

speaker: mary-magdalene
text: They have taken the Lord out of the tomb,
name: Mary Magdalene

speaker: mary-magdalene
text: and we do not know where they have put Him!
name: Mary Magdalene

speaker: angels
text: Woman, why are you weeping?
name: The two angels

speaker: mary-magdalene
text: Because they have taken my Lord away,
name: Mary Magdalene

speaker: mary-magdalene
text: and I do not know where they have put Him.
name: Mary Magdalene

speaker: jesus
text: Woman, why are you weeping?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Whom are you seeking?
name: Jesus

speaker: mary-magdalene
text: Sir, if you have carried Him off, tell me where you have put Him, and I will get Him.
name: Mary Magdalene

speaker: jesus
text: Mary.
name: Jesus

speaker: mary-magdalene
text: Rabboni!
name: Mary Magdalene

speaker: jesus
text: Do not cling to Me,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: for I have not yet ascended to the Father. But go and tell My brothers, ‘I am ascending to My Father and your Father, to My God and your God.’
name: Jesus

speaker: mary-magdalene
text: I have seen the Lord!
name: Mary Magdalene

speaker: jesus
text: Peace be with you!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Peace be with you. As the Father has sent Me, so also I am sending you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Receive the Holy Spirit.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If you forgive anyone his sins, they are forgiven; if you withhold forgiveness from anyone, it is withheld.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: We have seen the Lord!
name: The disciples

speaker: thomas
text: Unless I see the nail marks in His hands, and put my finger where the nails have been, and put my hand into His side, I will never believe.
name: Thomas

speaker: jesus
text: Peace be with you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Put your finger here and look at My hands. Reach out your hand and put it into My side. Stop doubting and believe.
name: Jesus

speaker: thomas
text: My Lord and my God!
name: Thomas

speaker: jesus
text: Because you have seen Me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: I am going fishing.
name: Simon Peter

speaker: disciples
text: We will go with you,
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Children, do you have any fish?
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: No,
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.
name: Jesus

speaker: beloved-disciple
text: It is the Lord!
name: The disciple whom Jesus loved

speaker: jesus
text: Bring some of the fish you have just caught.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Come, have breakfast,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Simon son of John, do you love Me more than these?
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Yes, Lord,
name: Simon Peter

speaker: peter
text: You know I love You.
name: Simon Peter

speaker: jesus
text: Feed My lambs.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Simon son of John, do you love Me?
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Yes, Lord,
name: Simon Peter

speaker: peter
text: You know I love You.
name: Simon Peter

speaker: jesus
text: Shepherd My sheep.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Simon son of John, do you love Me?
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Lord, You know all things,
name: Simon Peter

speaker: peter
text: You know I love You.
name: Simon Peter

speaker: jesus
text: Feed My sheep.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly, truly, I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted; but when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and someone else will dress you and lead you where you do not want to go.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Follow Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Lord, what about him?
name: Simon Peter

speaker: jesus
text: If I want him to remain until I return, what is that to you? You follow Me!
name: Jesus
